<sense>
<definition>(v. 
<xref rid="H00935">חָכַךְ I</xref>) 
<italic>gold hooks over the female bosom</italic> (h. כּוּמָז).</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Ex. XXXV, 22 (ed. Amst. מָחוּךְ); Num. XXXI, 50.—Sabb. 64

<italic>ma</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>okh</italic> (obscenity, v. preced.), v. גִּיחוּךְ.—
<plural-form>Pl. מְחוֹכִין, מְחוֹכַיָּא</plural-form>. Targ. Y. Ex. l. c.; Targ. Y. I Num. l. c. (not מהוכיא; Y. II מָעוֹכַיָּא).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>b</sup>. Y. Kil. IV. 29

<italic>ma</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>ol</italic> apply to a small vineyard. Ib. יש לו מ' the law does apply to it. Ib. ניטל המ' (prob. to be read בטל) it has no more the nature of a 
<italic>ma</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>ol</italic></notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>chorus of singers and dancers</italic>.</definition>

<definition>
<italic>strike, an instrument for levelling a measure of grain</italic> &c. Kel. XVII, 16; Tosef. ib.</definition>

<plural-form>Pl. מְחוֹקִים</plural-form>. Y. Yoma I, 38
<sup>c</sup> bot. Lev. R. s. 21 מְחוֹקיהֶן של כסף the strikes sent with the measures were of silver.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>cycle</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 59
<sup>b</sup> כל כ"ח שנין דהדר מ' Ms. M. (ed. והדר) every twenty eight years when the (solar) cycle begins anew.—
<plural-form>Pl. מַחֲזורִין</plural-form>. Targ. Y. I Gen. I, 14.—[In later Hebrew: מחזור גדול 
<italic>the solar cycle</italic> of twenty eight years; מ' קטון 
<italic>the lunar cycle</italic> of nineteen years.—In liturgy: מ' 
<italic>prayerbook for the festivals</italic>.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M00849">
<head-word>מָחַט</head-word>

<language-key> Ar.)</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (denom. of next w.; v. Kel. XIII, 8 התקינה לנר) 
<italic>to snuff, trim</italic> with a pin.</definition>
<notes> Bets. 32
<sup>b</sup> מוֹחֲטִין את וכ' you may trim the wick; expl. ib. עדויי חושכא to remove the charred top; Y. ib. IV, 62
<sup>c</sup> bot.—Sabb. 90
<sup>a</sup>; Men. 107
<sup>a</sup> שמוחטין בה וכ' Ar., Rashi a. Ms. M. Men. (ed. 
<pgbrk id="pg759" />מחטטין) it was used for trimming the wicks and cleansing the snouts of the candlestick.—[מוֹחֶטֶת, v. יָחַט.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M00850">
<head-word>מַחַט</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (חוּט I) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>needle, pin</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. VI, 1 מ' שאינה נקיבה a 
<italic>ma</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>at</italic> without a hole, i.e. a dress or hair-pin; ib. 3 מ' הנקובה a needle. Ib. I, 3 לא יצא החייט במַחֲטוֹ וכ' the tailor must not go out with his needle near Sabbath eve; ib. 11
<sup>b</sup> במ' התחובה וכ' with his needle stuck in his garment; Tosef. ib. I, 8. Sabb. XVII, 2 מ' של יד a small (sewing) needle, של סקאיס the sack-needle (for loose and coarse webs); Kel. XIII, 5. Y. M. Kat. I, 80
<sup>d</sup> bot. Orl. I, 4, v. מִיתּוּחַ; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>stitch</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. B. Kam. X, end, 7
<sup>c</sup> מלא מ' the length of a stitch which those of … interpreted to mean כפליים כמלא מ' double the length of a stitch; Bar Ḳ. used the expression מלא משיכת המ' וכ' as much as is required for making a stitch (carrying the needle), which R. J. interpreted (כפליים) כמשיכת המ' double &c.; Bab. ib. 119
<sup>b</sup> מלא מ' וחוץ למ' כמלא מ' the length of a stitch and besides it a thread the length of a stitch (Rashi: the length of a needle).—
<plural-form>Pl. מַחֲטִים, מַחֲטִין</plural-form> (m.). Y. Kidd. I, 58
<sup>c</sup> bot.; Y. Shebu. VI, beg. 36
<sup>d</sup> שני מ' two needles (or pins). Sabb. 96
<sup>b</sup> תופרי … זורקין מַחֲטֵיהֶן וכ' the embroiderers of curtains threw their 
<italic>spools</italic> (v. מִיתּוּחַ) one to the other; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M00851">
<head-word>מַחֲטָא</head-word>

<entry id="M00857">
<head-word>מחי</head-word>
<head-word>מָחָה</head-word>
<head-word>, (, </head-word>
<head-word>מָחַח)</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> v. 
<xref rid="M00346">מָהָה</xref>) 
<italic>to rub, wipe out; to wear out, destroy</italic>.</definition>
<notes> [In Talm. mostly מָחַק.] Erub. 13
<sup>a</sup>; Sot. II, 4 (17
<sup>b</sup>) (ref. to ומחה, Num. V, 23) כתב שיכול לִמְחוֹת (Mish. להִמָּחֵק) a writing which one can wash off. Gen. R. s. 23 (play on מחויאל, Gen. IV, 18) מוֹחָן אני וכ' I shall wipe them out of the world; a. e.—V. מָחוּי.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>מִיחָה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to strike out, annul</italic>,] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to protest against</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 38
<sup>b</sup> מי' בפני שנים if he entered a protest against the illegitimate occupation of his property in the presence of two (v. מְחָאָה). Ib. וכי למָחוֹת וכ' must he protest in the occupant’s presence?—Keth. 11
<sup>a</sup> מִיחֲתָה she protested against her conversion in childhood. Pes. 88
<sup>a</sup> יכולה למחות she has the privilege of protesting (declaring her preference); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (with ב or ביד of the person) 
<italic>to forewarn, interfere, try to prevent</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 55
<sup>b</sup> bot. מפני שהיה לו … בחפני ולא מי' (not לחפני, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) it was for Ph. to forewarn Hofni, and he did not. Ib.
<sup>a</sup> שאם מִיחוּ בהם לא יקבלו מהם (Ms. M. מחו … קבלו) that if they warned them, they would not have heeded them. Pes. IV, 8, a. e. לא מיחו בידם they did not prohibit their doing so; a. fr.—Cant. <sup>a</sup> שמָחֲלוּ להם מוכסין to whom custom officers remitted the fine. Ib. לשם פלוני מָחַלְנוּ we remitted (the fine) for this man’s sake (individually). Ber. 12

<sup>a</sup> מְחוֹל לי על וכ' forgive me that particular sin (the seduction of Bathsheba); מָחוּל לך thou art forgiven; a. v. fr.—מ' על כבודו 
<italic>to forego the honor due to one’s self</italic>. Kidd. 32
<sup>a</sup> האב שמ' … כבודו מָחוּל if a father allows a son to omit the acts of reverence due to him, his honor is remitted (the son may avail himself of the permission); הרב שמ' וכ' but if a teacher gives permission &c.; a. fr.—Num. R. s. 19 שאין המוֹחֵל נעשה וכ' for he who is asked to forgive, must not be relentless (v. B. Kam. VIII, 7).</notes></sense></senses>

<entry id="M00890">
<head-word>מַחֲלוֹקֶת</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>

<language-reference>
<xref rid="unknown">מַחֲלֹקֶת; חָלַק)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>division; separation; difference, dissension, strife, faction</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 4 למה אין כתיב … נבראת המ' why are not the words ‘that it was good’ written about the second day of creation?… Because separation was created thereon (Gen. I, 6); אם מ' שהיא לתיקונו וכ' if to a separation which was made for the establishment and settlement of the world, ‘that it was good’ cannot be applied, how much less to a separation which tends to the confusion of the world! Ab. V, 17 מ' שהיא לשם שמים a dissension which is carried on for the sake of heaven (of truth, without selfish motives). Ber. 37
<sup>a</sup> עד מתי … בין המ' how long wilt thou put thy head between contending parties, i.e. why dost thou deviate from the established rule? Ib. 38
<sup>b</sup> במ' שנויה this has been taught under a controversy of opinion. Y. Peah I, 16
<sup>a</sup> בעלי מ' people who create strife. Y. Snh. I, 19
<sup>c</sup> top בתחלה לא היתה מ' וכ' in former days there were no conflicting opinions in Israel (they being settled by the Sanhedrin); Bab. ib. 88
<sup>b</sup> לא היו מרבין מ' וכ' they allowed no differences to spread &c.; Tosef. ib. VII, 1; Tosef. Ḥag. II, 9 מַחֲלוֹקוֹת (
<italic>pl.</italic>). B. Bath. 147
<sup>a</sup> אל תהיו במ' do not join a political faction. Hor. 11
<sup>b</sup> מפני מַחֲלוֹקָתוֹ של וכ' (not מחלקותו) on account of the contention of Adoniyah (who claimed the right of succession). Ib. כי איכא מ' בעיא וכ' wherever there was a contest between claimants, anointing was required; a. fr.—
<italic>Pl.</italic> מַחֲלוֹקוֹת. Sot. 47
<sup>b</sup> רבו מ' וכ' the factions in Israel became numerous. Tosef. Snh. l. c., v. supra. Meg. 3
<sup>a</sup> שלא ירבו מ' וכ' in order that dissensions may not spread &c.; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
